bio: Between Causses and Aubrac, the Burgarella family ushers you into this tastefully refurbished house. Downstairs, the Table de Romane brasserie celebrates hearty regional fare (calf’s head, tripoux (sheep tripe), while upstairs the swanky gourmet La Tour establishment allows the creative chef, visible from the open kitchen, to give free rein to his inspiration without losing sight of his Aveyron roots. A delicious gourmet halt on the banks of the Lot River under the aegis of Château de Calmont....
